description: Persistent evidence store for ARCS model-routing calibration runs.
purpose: Historized calibration envelopes + routing table so benchmark data survives session boundaries and informs future routing decisions.

files.calibration_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json: One file per calibration run. Contains: model, adrs tested, tiers tested, per-call results (gate_verdict, css, latency_s, parse_ok, exit_code), timestamp, corpus summary.
files.routing_table.json: Current routing decision + per-model summary stats (avg latency, parse success rate, coherence vs reference). Updated after each calibration run.
files.index.json: Manifest of all calibration runs: filename, date, models tested, adrs tested, outcome summary.
